journal.boundary: the Trial #2 D-7 authorisation is CONSUMED and the immutability boundary is crossed when the FIRST case_pose_started record is successfully fsynced. That record is written before the launcher process exists, so a death between the record and the process still counts as an execution: the bias is deliberate and can never permit a second execution under one D-7
journal.crash_semantics: a crash can lose only the record being written; a torn final line is dropped by the reader and reported, never repaired
journal.entered_vs_completed: case_entered when the runner begins preparing a case; case_pose_started when every setup and forced-state prerequisite has landed and the mechanism is about to be invoked; case_completed when a frozen status is final. A BLOCKED or unposable case never reaches case_pose_started
journal.format: append-only JSONL, one record per line, flushed and fsynced
journal.immutability: no update and no delete; completing a case twice or completing one that was never entered raises

partial_reading.completed_case: keeps exactly its recorded status and reason
partial_reading.incomplete_case: UNKNOWN_FROM_PRESERVED_EVIDENCE; no frozen PASS/FAIL/INVALID/BLOCKED is derived after the fact and no fabricated INVALID is fed to the checker
partial_reading.no_pose_started_and_no_valid_trial_end: TRIAL_NOT_STARTED; D-7 not consumed by execution; no aggregate
partial_reading.replay_never_synthesises: a trial_end, a status, or a repaired history
partial_reading.trial_end_prerequisites: every membership case has a durable completed record, none has two, and the aggregate came from the frozen checker over exactly those records, recorded with its input digest
partial_reading.valid_trial_end: TRIAL_COMPLETED with the frozen checker's aggregate

parent_state_schema.closed: a parent-state key the schema does not name is refused; every key has one consumer that creates it and one prover that observes it, and a test fails if either is missing
parent_state_schema.created_in: the launcher process, the caller each case describes; the harness's own signal state is changed only across the spawn and restored before the barrier
parent_state_schema.proof: at the post-pin barrier, from /proc/<launcher>: environ names, fd table and fdinfo flags, SigBlk and SigIgn, and what descriptors 0-2 refer to; M2's threads from the receipt's parent_shape against the control arm; F7's adjacency from the launcher's own pre-clone pipe2 and fcntl(F_DUPFD_CLOEXEC) records, followed from the exec descriptor the barrier proved at fd 0 -- never from the child's close_range calls
parent_state_schema.requirement_source: the declared state, never the consumer's derived fields, so a bypassed consumer cannot also empty the requirement

classification.FAIL: the mechanism was invoked under the frozen state and a decisive observation contradicts the frozen prediction, safe set, gate or executed-identity assertion; or a launch, including M2's control arm, did not return in bound
classification.INVALID: only when the result cannot honestly be evaluated: a forced state or posing precondition was not established, an evidence channel or a required measurement is missing, or the observation is not interpretable
classification.decisive_without_report: a report-based rule (argv_exact, environ_empty, fds_exactly_012, signals_reset, no_new_privs, interpreter_ran_with_devfd, privilege_transition_suppressed) with no usable report takes the lifecycle token when the record is decisive: an admission refusal, an explicit pre-exec status record, or a complete stdout holding no report. A truncated, malformed or undecidable stream, or no receipt, stays INVALID
classification.other_decisive_forms: an admitted run in a refusal case takes its lifecycle token; a refused run in a stream_exact case takes its refusal; a declared payload drained in full that is not the recipe renders stream_mismatch
classification.posing_checks: only preconditions the mechanism does not control: barrier landing, same_inode_as_writer (E5), exec_status_pair_adjacent (F7), threaded_parent_observed (M2), retention_observed (O6, P4), no_helper_report (S5), fixture_descendant_alive (O7)

o5.cpu_source: measured by the harness outside the launcher, from RUSAGE_CHILDREN across the one launch; includes the helper the launcher reaped, so it can only overstate
o5.poll_source: the launcher's instrumentation counter poll_returns_not_in_receipt, outside the receipt

o7.capture_failure_fact: the receipt's stderr.completeness == WriterRetainedAfterChildExit, reported beside the direct child's Exited:42
o7.construction: helper_fork --retain-stdio --parent-exit 42 --lifetime-ms P_DESCENDANT_LIFETIME_MS with the fork_helper liveness setup; helper_fork.c unchanged; no payload declared, because O7 freezes none
o7.exec_evidence: the same liveness answer; the fixture emits no report and O7 declares no payload
o7.posing_evidence: the fixture: helper_fork's build-identity binding, the declared helper arguments, and the descendant answering on the case-private liveness FIFO after launch() returned (posed check fixture_descendant_alive). The receipt's completeness is never posing evidence
o7.result: rule process_disposition must give Exited:42, and assertion stderr_capture_failure_reported must hold; the two receipt facts are recorded separately
o7.source: definition section 9.6, owner decision after f9bbf39
o7.stdout_retention: stdout is retained too; a fixture side-effect that is not an O7 verdict requirement

posing_versus_showing.posed: a forced state that cannot be proven, or a posed check that does not hold, leaves the case not posed, which the frozen checker scores INVALID
posing_versus_showing.repeated_trials: every repetition of a repeated case (O8, S7) is evaluated on its own into PASS, FAIL or INVALID; the case is FAIL if any repetition is FAIL, else INVALID if any is INVALID, else PASS. A known FAIL takes precedence over INVALID and no repetition stands for another (definition section 9.6)
posing_versus_showing.showed: the rule's token and the executed-identity assertions decide PASS or FAIL; a violated assertion replaces the token with its violation token, which is no case's expectation
posing_versus_showing.unobservable: an assertion whose evidence is missing, in a case that would otherwise PASS, leaves the case not posed; missing evidence is never success

post_pin_barrier.control_fd_lifetime: closed before clone3, so it can never reach the child or the executed image
post_pin_barrier.e5b_excluded: E5b's claim is that its writer is CLOSED before launch, so it does not use the barrier
post_pin_barrier.failure_semantics: no READY, a malformed channel, an action that fails, verification that fails, or CONTINUE undeliverable all close the socket without CONTINUE; the launcher ends at its own barrier and the case is not posed, which the frozen checker scores INVALID. Never a mechanism PASS or FAIL
post_pin_barrier.hook_location: after open/pin, fstat/classify, pre-exec measurement and the admission decision; before clone3, child setup and execveat
post_pin_barrier.mutation_owner: the Python harness; C only synchronises
post_pin_barrier.protocol: the launcher writes READY and waits under a bounded poll; the harness performs the action and proves it landed; the harness answers CONTINUE; the launcher closes the control descriptor
post_pin_barrier.purpose: the HARNESS lands a preregistered adversarial change on the external object after the launcher has pinned, measured and admitted it, and before anything is cloned or executed; and, for a case with a declared caller state, the harness proves that state present in the launcher from its own /proc entries before clone3
post_pin_barrier.t2_r1_note: the ten cases whose setup keys nothing read in Trial #1's driver; X8's key was cleanup, so X8 never used the barrier. The barrier set is derived from the plans and tested against barrier_cases

supersession_reason: fixes the reachable findings of the bounded independent delta review of e4f49f2, recorded at 43371c6 as TRIAL_2_NEEDS_BOUNDED_CORRECTION and corrected at 5e04642. Every finding was older than Trial #2. N-1: parent states were declared and never applied; they are now a closed contract created in the launcher and proven at the barrier from /proc, with two TEST/CONTROL-ONLY caller-state flags for F3, F6 and F7. N-2: executed identity is asserted -- marker, pre-exec measurement against the starting identity, and mode bits -- so a substituted body is a FAIL, never INVALID or PASS. N-3: E5's writer is proven against the launcher's pinned descriptor. N-4a: O5's CPU and poll() count are measured, missing is INVALID and exceeded is FAIL. N-4b: S2/S7's inert field became a setup whose capability changes mode after the launcher holds it. N-5: every durable case record carries normalised posing evidence. Also E6c's descriptor-free mapping, R4's gate, the barrier set versus the T2-R1 set, and stale wording. No case membership, class, prediction, safe set, gate, traced flag or block cause moved. launcher_spike.c changed, so Build 6 no longer covers it. Trial #1, its freeze and its result review, and the delta review record, are preserved unchanged.

traced_cases.note: a syscall record is collected ONLY for these cases. R, T, O, P and S cases are never traced, because ptrace notifies the tracer before the real parent and those cases measure the launcher's own waitid classification.

tracer_requirement.fallback: none; the ptrace fallback the definition once promised is withdrawn
tracer_requirement.not_a_block_cause: tracer unavailability is never clone3_unavailable and never a conditional BLOCKED cause
tracer_requirement.on_failure: preflight HALT before the first preregistered case
tracer_requirement.statement: A usable strace >= 5.4 is a mandatory pretrial environment requirement. If strace is absent, older than the floor, or cannot render the trace contract the traced cases depend on, the runner HALTS before the first preregistered case. No ptrace, eBPF, helper-binary or root-requiring fallback exists or may be added for 0.1.

acquisition.cache_rule: only a complete validated snapshot is cached, as an immutable frozenset; failed and partial loads cache nothing, so no partially initialised import can poison the cache for the life of the process
acquisition.on_refusal: evidence.VocabularyUnavailable propagates out of Sanitiser.text, Sanitiser.record and serialise; no partially sanitised evidence is emitted and no empty vocabulary is substituted
acquisition.readiness_signal: driver.registry_vocabulary(), defined as the LAST statement of driver's module body, so its presence proves every registry is populated; a partially initialised driver simply does not have it
acquisition.recovery: the first call after the driver finishes initialising returns the complete vocabulary; verified from a fresh interpreter for every refused state above
refused_states: partially initialised driver with the registries absent
a required registry missing from the snapshot
a registry of the wrong type
a registry holding a value that is not a name
an accessor that is not callable or that raises
a snapshot that is not a mapping
acquisition.second_source_of_truth: none; the accessor returns the registries themselves
